Lakelands Waterfront Villas

Villa in Laguna
HomeNew ProjectsLakelands Waterfront Villas

Marketing images, mostly artist renders. Layouts and finishes may differ from the final product.

Project overview

A collection of lakeside four-bedroom pool villas set within the roughly one-square-kilometre Laguna Phuket estate. The project is described as 14 exclusive units, with lagoon and hill views and access to the estate's trails and private beach club.

Facilities & amenities

  • Hillside, Orchard, Forest and Lakeside precincts
  • 15 km trail network
  • Private beachfront club
  • Hillside adventure park
  • Sports and aquatic complex
  • Town center
  • 24-hour concierge
  • Security
  • Car park
